names: UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision
summary: UCSF's Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois Street, a 347,500-sq-ft eye-care facility in three buildings (a 12-story tower with a 5-story south wing and a 3-story north wing) that SF YIMBY reported open on November 27, 2020, at a reported cost of about $237 million (SmithGroup architect). It stands on OCII plan block 33, between Third St and Illinois St: the City's address point for 490 Illinois St falls inside this outline, and UCSF's own 2025 campus map labels block 33 'Valley Center for Vision'. Its footprint here is approximate (see the shape's accuracy caveat).

milestones.text: UC Regents approve a $237,000,000 project budget and design for UCSF's new Center for Vision Neurosciences building at Mission Bay, which UCSF calls 'Block 33', combining the Department of Ophthalmology and the Francis I. Proctor Foundation in a 12-story tower with a 5-story south wing and 3-story north wing; construction was expected to begin June 2017 with completion targeted for July 2019
SF YIMBY reports (2020-11-27) that UCSF's Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois Street has opened; the exact opening date is not given

347,500 across three separate buildings (12-story tower, 5-story south wing, 3-story north wing), plus parking for over 200 vehicles across 75,000 sq ft
Opened for the University of California, San Francisco; the nonprofit That Man May See provided fundraising for the construction (SF YIMBY).

open_questions: No source read gives the exact opening day: SF YIMBY reported the building open on November 27, 2020, without a date.

UCSF's news page for the January 2017 Regents approval could not be read (it refuses automated fetches, and no archived copy was found); the Regents date and the expected 2017-2019 schedule rest on earlier notes of that page, not a direct read. Its $237,000,000 budget and 12-, 5- and 3-story massing match SF YIMBY's article, which was read.
No opening date was found for Caffe Central at 490 Illinois St: the cafe's own page lists the location and its hours but gives no date.

OpenStreetMap labels one of the 409/499 Illinois St buildings across Illinois St (way 84821722, 6 levels, 28 m) as 490 Illinois St. The City's address point, UCSF's 2025 campus map and SF YIMBY's description all place the 12-story Valley Center for Vision here instead, so that label is not used.

Geometry: this building's east edge sits close to, but not necessarily exactly on, Illinois St's west curb line; it has not been checked against a building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints, surveyed in 2010, predates the building).
